topic: Grok Build: xAI's Open-Source Agent Framework Deep Dive

key_points: Open-sourced July 14, 2026 under Apache 2.0 license
Written in Rust, 20K+ GitHub stars, 3.6K forks
Full-screen TUI with mouse interaction, headless mode for CI/scripting
ACP (Agent Client Protocol) for editor integration
MCP (Model Context Protocol) support for tool integration
Plan Mode with human approval gates for safe code generation
Parallel subagents for multi-task execution
Skills, plugins, hooks system for extensibility
Sandboxed execution environment
Grok Build 0.1 model scores 40/100 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
Pricing: $1.00/1M input tokens, $2.00/1M output tokens (competitive)
Speed: 95.4 tokens/second (above average)
256K context window supporting text and image input
Very verbose — 130M output tokens for evaluation (2x average)
Reasoning model variant available
Cost to evaluate: $375.01 on Intelligence Index
Privacy controversy: Grok Build uploaded entire Git repos to Google Cloud Storage
Wire-level analysis by researcher Cereblab revealed data exfiltration
Full Git history including deleted secrets and .env files transmitted
Elon Musk publicly committed to deleting all previously uploaded data
Server-side fix applied (disable_codebase_upload: true)
Privacy command added but found to be data-retention setting, not upload blocker
Comparisons drawn to Claude Code, Gemini, Codex which only open individual files
Production toolkit and living showcase for Grok Build 0.1
Includes reusable skills, custom MCP servers, and real projects
Flagship project: Agent Observability Dashboard (agent-failure-analyzer on PyPI)
Showcases: Subagent Arena Visualizer, MCP Control Center, Smart Test Engine
Demonstrates Plan Mode discipline, parallel subagents, MCP integration
MIT licensed, maintained by Cobus Greyling
xAI preparing credits-based pricing model for Grok Build
Model Arena feature: multiple agents tackle same task in parallel
Users can run tasks locally via CLI or remotely via web interface
Hybrid model: monthly credits bundled with subscription + on-demand purchases
Similar monetization approach to Claude Code and OpenAI Codex
